items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I can't copy too much of that stuff. Because I would really sound too mechanical if I stood like guys like Ron Loinie(?), sitting right next door to... George Lewis, note for note.

ctx.x: they played. But in the first place, I'm a very poor copier. I can't copy too much of that stuff. Because I would really sound too mechanical if I stood like guys like Ron Loinie(?), sitting right next door to... George Lewis, note for note.
